description_en: Queries the list of desktop agent runtimes
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center list-desktop-agent-runtime --agent-provider OpenClaw --model-template-id mt-xxxx --desktop-ids ecd-xxxx --agent-template-ids example-string --resource-ids ecd-xxxx --desktop-statuses Running --auth-users user-001 --agent-instance-versions 2026.3.13 --agent-instance-statuses Running --deployment-source Admin --model-configure true --channel-configure true --resource-group-id rg-xxxx --desktop-names Agent-001 --biz-type 1 --agent-platform ENTERPRISE --has-auth-user true --include-risk-info true --has-risk true --management-status Hibernated --agent-im-online-status Online --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-xxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-size 20 --page-number 1 --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDesktopAgentRuntime

parameters.help_en: The agent provider name
parameters.name: agent_provider

parameters.help_en: The agent platform
parameters.name: agent_platform

parameters.help_en: The list of agent platforms. If AgentPlatform is also specified, AgentPlatform takes precedence and this list is ignored
parameters.help_zh: Agent平台列表（与 AgentPlatform 同时传时以 AgentPlatform 为准，本列表被忽略）
parameters.name: agent_platform_list

parameters.help_en: The list of agent providers. If AgentProvider is also specified, AgentProvider takes precedence and this list is ignored
parameters.help_zh: Agent提供商列表（与 AgentProvider 同时传时以 AgentProvider 为准，本列表被忽略）
parameters.name: agent_provider_list

parameters.help_en: The model group ID
parameters.name: model_template_id

parameters.help_en: The list of agent runtime IDs
parameters.name: desktop_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of agent template IDs. A match occurs only when all valid templates are assigned
parameters.help_zh: Agent模板ID列表（所有有效模板均已分配才命中）
parameters.name: agent_template_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of resource IDs (underlying actual resource IDs)
parameters.help_zh: 资源ID列表（底层真实资源ID）
parameters.name: resource_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of Cloud Desktop statuses
parameters.name: desktop_statuses

parameters.help_en: The list of authorized users
parameters.name: auth_users

parameters.help_en: The list of agent instance versions
parameters.name: agent_instance_versions

parameters.help_en: The list of agent instance statuses
parameters.name: agent_instance_statuses

parameters.help_en: The deployment source
parameters.name: deployment_source

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether a model is configured
parameters.name: model_configure

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether a third-party channel is configured
parameters.name: channel_configure

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The list of agent runtime names
parameters.name: desktop_names

parameters.help_en: The business type
parameters.name: biz_type

parameters.help_en: Indicates whether an authorized user exists for authorization
parameters.name: has_auth_user

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to query and return risk information. Default value: false. If set to true, the response includes the RiskInfo field, and the HasRisk filter takes effect
parameters.help_zh: 是否查询并返回风险信息。默认为 false。设置为 true 时，响应中将包含 RiskInfo 字段，同时 HasRisk 筛选条件才会生效
parameters.name: include_risk_info

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether a risk exists. This parameter is used to filter Cloud Desktops with or without risks and takes effect only when IncludeRiskInfo is set to true.

Set this parameter to true to return only records with risks. Set this parameter to false to return only records without risks. If you do not specify this parameter, no filtering is applied
parameters.help_zh:
是否存在风险。用于过滤有风险或无风险的云电脑，仅当 IncludeRiskInfo 为 true 时生效。

设置为 true 表示仅返回存在风险的记录，设置为 false 表示仅返回无风险的记录，不传则不做过滤
parameters.name: has_risk

parameters.help_en: The management status filter, such as Hibernated
parameters.name: management_status

parameters.help_en: The agent IM online status filter
parameters.help_zh: Agent IM 在线状态过滤
parameters.name: agent_im_online_status

parameters.help_en: The office network ID
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en: The business region ID
parameters.name: biz_region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Starts from 1. Values 0 and 1 return the same result
parameters.help_zh: 页码，从1开始，0和1返回相同结果
parameters.name: page_number
